items.title: CBRE’s (NYSE:CBRE) Q2 CY2026 Earnings Results: Revenue In Line With Expectations
items.summary: Commercial real estate firm CBRE (NYSE:CBRE) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 15.5% year on year to $11.23 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.56 per share was 5.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
